description: The pie chart is divided into five segments, each representing a different category related to the Nondeterministic Polynomial-time Problem Challenge. The categories are Complexity, Instance, Unhackable, Coverage, and General. The Complexity segment is yellow and occupies approximately one-fifth of the chart. The Instance segment is blue and also takes up about one-fifth of the chart. The Unhackable segment is light blue and is slightly larger than the other segments, covering roughly one-third of the chart. The Coverage segment is green and is about one-fifth of the chart. The General segment is red and is the smallest, making up a little more than one-tenth of the chart. There are no percentage labels inside the slices, and no legend is included. The segments are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
